Miami Heat GTA 6 Jerseys Go On Sale November 18
Oh, and Travis Scott is involved too
By RC Staff
06 November 2026
Key Points
The Nike x Cactus Jack Vice City jersey goes on sale at Kaseya Center on November 18
Pricing is unannounced, but we expect $120 to $150 retail and a quick sellout
The Heat have only confirmed an in-person sale but have email sign-ups open for an online drop
The wait is over. After weeks of teasers, the Miami Heat finally pulled the curtain back on the jersey at the center of A Night in Vice City, and it’s every bit as loud as GTA fans hoped. Black and pink, “Vice City” across the chest, and Travis Scott’s Cactus Jack label stitched into the tag. Rockstar has turned downtown Miami into a giant GTA 6 billboard ahead of the game’s November 19 launch, and nearly every piece of tie-in merch has moved fast on the secondary market. This jersey looks like the biggest flip of the bunch, and the Heat haven’t even told us what it costs yet.
Miami Heat Vice City Jersey Details
The Heat revealed the Nike x Cactus Jack Vice City uniform this morning, confirming Travis Scott is officially part of the collab. The jersey swaps the usual “Miami” wordmark for “Vice City” in a black and pink colorway, and it carries a Cactus Jack patch and tag along with a GTA VI patch. Nike is producing it in Swingman sizing, and it features the same NBA authenticity badge you’d find on any other official jersey.
There’s strong precedent for demand. We’ve tracked all kind of GTA 6 merch reselling for a profit, from individual foam fingers to empty beer cans . Travis Scott is also working with Rockstar and Nike on GTA 6 Air Force 1s dropping November 19.
These GTA 6 Jerseys Will Resell
No price has been announced, but Nike Swingman jerseys with collab branding typically land somewhere between $120 and $150. We wouldn’t be surprised to see them reselling for north of $300, as long as they sell out quickly.
The early merch is a good sign. Today the Heat moved several Vice City pieces from the Kaseya Center’s in-arena store to its online capsule, and both the $168 satin bomber and the $120 “Welcome to Vice City” neon sign sold out quickly. We’ve already seen at least one neon sign resell for over $400.
The confirmed sale is in person at Kaseya Center during A Night in Vice City on November 18. It’s not clear if the Heat will be selling the jerseys online before or during the game, or if they will be distributed exclusively at the Kaseya Center. If that is the case, expect to see the jerseys reselling for significantly more than what they would after an online drop. If you’re in the Miami area, tickets for the November 18 game are still available with $137 SRO entry your cheapest get-in option.
The biggest risk is supply. “Limited” could mean a few thousand units or far more, and a big run would cap prices. A return policy hasn’t been announced, and limited collab drops are often final sale, so check the terms at checkout before buying multiples.

Travis Scott X Miami Heat GTA 6 Collection Drops 11/20
Hats, tees, hoodies, and (maybe) jerseys
By RC Staff
17 November 2026
Key Points
Cactus Jack’s Vice City collection releases online November 20 through SNKRS, Fanatics, and NBA Store
Two “styles” will only be sold in person at Kaseya Center on November 18
No prices or exact release times have been announced
Cactus Jack confirmed today that its lifestyle collection with Nike, the Miami Heat, and Rockstar Games will get a limited online release on November 20, two days after it debuts inside Kaseya Center. That changes the math for resellers who were treating this as an arena-only grab. There is a catch, though: Scott has confirmed that “two styles” will remain exclusive to the Kaseya Center. Whether that statement refers to the jerseys or something else is still unclear.
New Miami Heat GTA 6 Capsule Details
The collection launches November 18 for A Night in Vice City, when the Heat host the Milwaukee Bucks and wear a Cactus Jack edition uniform on court. It goes on sale inside the arena’s Miami HEAT Store when doors open at 5 PM ET, and that in-person sale includes the two arena-exclusive styles. On November 20, the collection rolls out in limited quantities on the SNKRS app, Fanatics, and NBA Store, followed by a release on cactusjack.com .
New images show hoodies, hats, graphic tees, and more alongside the black and pink jerseys and matching shorts we covered in our original Vice City jersey breakdown . No prices have been posted for any item.
This is separate from the Heat’s Court Culture Vice City line already sold through the team store, but that line proved the demand. A $168 satin bomber and a $120 neon sign both sold out quickly, and at least one sign has resold for over $400.
Why Resellers are Interested
The arena exclusives are the clear best bet. Anything you can only buy inside Kaseya Center on one night will have a hard supply cap, and those pieces should do well on eBay. So far, the Heat have only confirmed that the Vice City jerseys will be sold in person at the arena. Cactus Jack’s mention of two arena-exclusive styles points toward the jerseys, but that’s not a solid confirmation, and the post could be referring to other items.
If the jerseys truly are arena-only, we think they could run up to $1,000 on eBay. If they’re part of the online drop, prices will be lower, but they should still be very profitable. GTA 6 hype plus Travis Scott’s name is a strong combination, and “limited quantities” on SNKRS usually leaves plenty of buyers empty-handed. Online release times have not been posted yet.
You’ll need a game ticket to reach the arena store. As we noted in our Night in Vice City ticket coverage , the cheapest seats are standing room only and obstructed view, and the lowest get-in price is still $137. For Miami readers attending, this still looks like the most lucrative way to play the drop. Everyone else should plan to pull themselves away from GTA 6 for a few hours on November 20. We’ll update once Cactus Jack confirms prices, drop times, and which styles are arena-only.

This week, the world will finally get its hands on Grand Theft Auto 6 . Fans of the series have waited 13 years for the latest GTA game, so Rockstar Games have gone above and beyond to promote the newest take on a fictionalized Miami, Vice City. South Florida as a whole has started to transform, with businesses from the game being brought to life, in-universe advertisements plastered across billboards, and the Miami Heat hosting “A Night in Vice City” just one day before GTA 6 launches.
There’s much more to discuss, but we’re focused on the Heat’s partnership with Rockstar Games, Nike, and Travis Scott , who recently unveiled Vice City uniforms . In addition to the uniforms and the three GTA 6 Travis Scott Air Force 1s , a lifestyle apparel collection is also being released to celebrate the game.
Cactus Jack x Miami Heat x GTA 6 x Nike Apparel Details
The off-the-court lifestyle apparel collection from Travis Scott’s Cactus Jack brings GTA 6’s Vice City energy to the Miami Heat across a variety of items. Previewed in this Instagram post are hoodies, T-shirts, hats, and long-sleeve shirts.
Of course, Travis Scott flips and reverses Nike branding details across the collection, as seen on the white and pink T-shirt featuring GTA 6 logos on the sleeves and references to Vice City, Nike, and Cactus Jack on the back. A camo shirt features 3M reflective Vice City branding on the chest, while the black hat places a Heat logo on the front, a Nike Air logo on the right side, and Cactus Jack and Rockstar logos on the left.
